note: 朋友聚会, 同学聚会, 参加聚会. Informal and friendly.

examples.zh: 周末我们有一次同学聚会，你来吗？
examples.en: We have a classmates' get-together this weekend. Are you coming?

examples.zh: 很久没聚会了，大家找个时间见见吧。
examples.en: We haven't got together in a long time; let's find a time to meet.

examples.zh: 昨天的聚会太热闹了！
examples.en: Yesterday's party was so lively!

note: 请确认 is common in notices and apps; for people, 确定 = to settle on, 确认 = verify a fact.

examples.zh: 请确认你的电话号码。
examples.en: Please confirm your phone number.

examples.zh: 我想确认，会议是不是三点开始？
examples.en: I'd like to confirm: does the meeting start at three?

examples.zh: 订好房间以后，酒店会给你发短信确认。
examples.en: After you book a room, the hotel will text you to confirm.

note: Uncountable in feel: 查资料 = look up information; 一份资料 = a set of documents.

examples.zh: 我正在网上查资料，准备明天的报告。
examples.en: I'm looking up material online to prepare tomorrow's report.

examples.zh: 这份资料很有用，谢谢你。
examples.en: This material is very useful. Thank you.

examples.zh: 请把你的资料发到我的邮箱。
examples.en: Please send your documents to my email.

meaning: circle, ring; to circle (draw a ring around)

senses.en: circle, ring; to circle (draw a ring around)

note: 圈 as verb: 把……圈出来 = circle it. Also: 朋友圈 (WeChat Moments / social circle).

examples.zh: 请在正确的答案上画一个圈。
examples.en: Please draw a circle around the correct answer.

examples.zh: 我每天在公园里跑三圈。
examples.en: I run three laps in the park every day.

examples.zh: 老师把重要的词都圈出来了。
examples.en: The teacher circled all the important words.

note: Casual word for 头: 脑袋疼, 动脑袋 (use your head). Not for formal medical talk.

examples.zh: 我的脑袋好疼，想睡一会儿。
examples.en: My head really hurts; I want to sleep for a while.

examples.zh: 你动动脑袋，想想别的办法。
examples.en: Use your head and think of another way.

examples.zh: 小心，别碰到脑袋！
examples.en: Careful, don't bump your head!

note: Used for couples; also for friends or partners going separate ways.

examples.zh: 他们谈了三年，上个月分手了。
examples.en: They dated for three years and broke up last month.

examples.zh: 你为什么要跟她分手？
examples.en: Why do you want to break up with her?

examples.zh: 在车站分手的时候，我们都哭了。
examples.en: When we parted at the station, we both cried.

note: 心理医生, 心理压力, 心理健康. Often paired with 身体 (physical).

examples.zh: 他最近工作压力很大，需要看心理医生。
examples.en: He's under great work pressure lately and needs to see a psychologist.

examples.zh: 孩子的心理健康和身体健康一样重要。
examples.en: A child's mental health is as important as physical health.

examples.zh: 我对心理很有兴趣。
examples.en: I'm very interested in psychology.

meaning: measure word for items, tasks, rules, projects

senses.en: measure word for items, tasks, rules, projects

note: Formal: 一项任务, 一项计划, 三项规定. Rather than 个 in written or work language.

examples.zh: 这项任务必须在明天前完成。
examples.en: This task must be completed before tomorrow.

examples.zh: 公司有三项新规定，请大家看一看。
examples.en: The company has three new rules; please take a look, everyone.

examples.zh: 他提出了一项很好的计划。
examples.en: He put forward a very good plan.

note: 提醒 + person + (to do): 提醒我带伞. 请提醒一下 = "please remind".

examples.zh: 明天有会，你提醒我吧。
examples.en: There's a meeting tomorrow; please remind me.

examples.zh: 谢谢你提醒我，我都快忘了。
examples.en: Thanks for reminding me; I had almost forgotten.

examples.zh: 医生提醒他，不要吃太咸。
examples.en: The doctor warned him not to eat food that is too salty.

meaning: excited, moved (emotionally); to stir up feelings

senses.en: excited, moved (emotionally); to stir up feelings

note: Strong emotion, can be joyful or angry; more emotional than 兴奋.

examples.zh: 听到这个好消息，她激动得哭了。
examples.en: Hearing the good news, she was so moved that she cried.

examples.zh: 你先别激动，慢慢说。
examples.en: Don't get worked up; speak slowly.

examples.zh: 马上就要见到他们了，我好激动。
examples.en: I'm about to see them, and I'm so excited.

note: Pattern: 不是……而是……. 而是 corrects what came before.

examples.zh: 我不是不想去，而是没有时间。
examples.en: It's not that I don't want to go; I just don't have the time.

examples.zh: 他要的不是钱，而是你的理解。
examples.en: What he wants is not money but your understanding.

examples.zh: 这不是我的问题，而是方法的问题。
examples.en: This is not my problem; it's a problem with the method.

note: 打牌 = play cards; 牌子 = brand or sign; 名牌 = famous brand.

examples.zh: 周末在家里，我们常常一起打牌。
examples.en: At weekends at home, we often play cards together.

examples.zh: 这个牌子的手机怎么样？
examples.en: How is this brand of phone?

examples.zh: 门口挂着一块小牌，上面写着欢迎。
examples.en: A small sign hangs at the door that says 'Welcome'.

note: 有权利做…… = have the right to. 权利 = rights; duty is 义务.

examples.zh: 每个人都有说话的权利。
examples.en: Everyone has the right to speak.

examples.zh: 病人有权利知道自己的情况。
examples.en: Patients have the right to know their own condition.

examples.zh: 你没有权利看我的手机。
examples.en: You have no right to look at my phone.

meaning: to take out, pull out; to draw (a lot); to smoke; to spare (time)

senses.en: to take out, pull out; to draw (a lot); to smoke; to spare (time)

note: 抽烟 = smoke; 抽空 = find time; 抽签 = draw lots; 抽血 = draw blood.

examples.zh: 对不起，这里不能抽烟。
examples.en: Sorry, you can't smoke here.

examples.zh: 护士抽了一点儿血，明天就有结果。
examples.en: The nurse drew a little blood, and the result will be ready tomorrow.

examples.zh: 你再忙，也要抽时间休息。
examples.en: However busy you are, you should make time to rest.

note: As a surname, 王 is among the most common: 王老师, 老王 (informal).

examples.zh: 这位是王经理，负责我们的新项目。
examples.en: This is Manager Wang, who is in charge of our new project.

examples.zh: 我姓王，是北京人。
examples.en: My surname is Wang, and I'm from Beijing.

examples.zh: 这个故事里有一个年轻的王。
examples.en: There's a young king in this story.

note: Used for war, games, and figuratively: 健康的敌人 = health's enemy.

examples.zh: 在这个游戏里，你要打败所有敌人。
examples.en: In this game, you have to defeat all the enemies.

examples.zh: 他们不是敌人，是朋友。
examples.en: They are not enemies; they are friends.

examples.zh: 吸烟是健康的敌人。
examples.en: Smoking is the enemy of health.

meaning: to inhale, suck in; to absorb; to attract

senses.en: to inhale, suck in; to absorb; to attract

note: 吸烟 = smoke; 吸引 = attract. 吸一口气 = take a breath.

examples.zh: 请先吸一口气，别紧张。
examples.en: Please take a breath first and don't be nervous.

examples.zh: 这种纸很能吸水。
examples.en: This kind of paper absorbs water well.

examples.zh: 医院里不能吸烟。
examples.en: You can't smoke in the hospital.

note: 面对挑战, 接受挑战, 挑战自己. Often positive.

examples.zh: 这份新工作对我是一个大挑战。
examples.en: This new job is a big challenge for me.

examples.zh: 他想挑战自己，去爬那座山。
examples.en: He wants to challenge himself by climbing that mountain.

examples.zh: 你敢接受这个挑战吗？
examples.en: Do you dare accept this challenge?

note: 家庭地址, 邮寄地址, 网址 (web address). Ask: 你的地址是什么？

examples.zh: 请把你的地址写在这里。
examples.en: Please write your address here.

examples.zh: 你告诉我地址，我去找你。
examples.en: Tell me the address and I'll come find you.

examples.zh: 这个地址不对，快递寄不到。
examples.en: This address is wrong, so the package can't be delivered.

note: Links two events in sequence: 下雨了，于是我们没去. Narrative, not "therefore" for logic.

examples.zh: 外面下雨了，于是我们没出去。
examples.en: It started raining, so we didn't go out.

examples.zh: 他觉得很累，于是早回家了。
examples.en: He felt tired, so he went home early.

examples.zh: 大家都同意，于是事情就这样决定了。
examples.en: Everyone agreed, and so the matter was decided.
